mismatches.say: A nonresident may drive a car not registered here for an aggregate of thirty days per calendar year without Michigan security.
mismatches.heard: A non-resident may drive a car, not registered here, for an aggregate of 30 days per calendar year without Michigan's security.

mismatches.say: Ride-share drivers logged on but not on a ride need at least fifty thousand dollars and one hundred thousand dollars bodily injury and twenty-five thousand dollars property damage. During a prearranged ride: one million dollars combined single limit.
mismatches.heard: Rideshare drivers logged on, but not on a ride need, at least $50,000 and $100,000 bodily injury and $25,000 property damage. During a pre-arranged ride, $1 million combined single limit.

mismatches.say: The Assigned Claims Plan is run by the Michigan Automobile Insurance Placement Facility, the M A I P F. Every insurer authorized to write auto insurance here must take part.
mismatches.heard: The assigned claims plan is run by the Michigan Automobile Insurance Placement Facility, the M, a IPF. Every insurer authorized to write auto insurance here must take part.

mismatches.say: Assigned Claims Plan claimants must notify the M A I P F within one year after the accident. Medical benefits there are generally capped at two hundred fifty thousand dollars.
mismatches.heard: Assigned claims plan claimants must notify the M, a IPF within one year after the accident. Medical benefits, there are generally capped at $250,000.
